name: @molcrafts/molvis-plugins-official
description: Official MolVis plugin collection meta. Version MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH: major=plugin system, minor=plugin count (4), patch=fixes. Children keep independent versions.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @molcrafts/molvis-plugin-lammps-input-generator && npm run build -w @molcrafts/molvis-plugin-alchemist && npm run build -w @molcrafts/molvis-plugin-pyodide-molpy && npm run build -w @molcrafts/molvis-plugin-carbon-tube-builder && npm run build:meta
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @molcrafts/molvis-plugin-lammps-input-generator && npm run typecheck -w @molcrafts/molvis-plugin-alchemist && npm run typecheck -w @molcrafts/molvis-plugin-pyodide-molpy && npm run typecheck -w @molcrafts/molvis-plugin-carbon-tube-builder && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test -w @molcrafts/molvis-plugin-lammps-input-generator && npm run test -w @molcrafts/molvis-plugin-alchemist && npm run test -w @molcrafts/molvis-plugin-pyodide-molpy && npm run test -w @molcrafts/molvis-plugin-carbon-tube-builder
scripts.check: npm run check:contract && npm run check:manifests && npm run check:meta-version && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.preview:pyodide: npm run build -w @molcrafts/molvis-plugin-pyodide-molpy && npx --yes serve -l 4174 --cors plugins/pyodide-molpy
scripts.check:contract: node scripts/check-vendored-contract.mjs && npm run check:contract -w @molcrafts/molvis-plugin-lammps-input-generator && npm run check:contract -w @molcrafts/molvis-plugin-alchemist && npm run check:contract -w @molcrafts/molvis-plugin-pyodide-molpy && npm run check:contract -w @molcrafts/molvis-plugin-carbon-tube-builder
